 Grazer AK [...] On Sunday (November 1), Galo travel to Porto Alegre for the first leg against Grêmio for a place in the final of the national competition. Galo sit sixth in the Brasileirão with 50 points, four behind third-placed Cruzeiro.

### Everson could return after nearly two months [...] ### Tomás Cuello and Fred expected to remain sidelined

Forward Tomás Cuello, who suffered a rib injury, is expected to remain out of the team. Defensive midfielder Fred is also unlikely to feature in the derby as he recovers from a left hamstring injury.

Atlético-MG also have other absentees, including center-back Vitor Hugo, who is suspended after receiving his third yellow card against Flamengo. These absences limit Eduardo Domínguez's options when selecting his team.
